newsitem.title: JAPAN: Weak yen not affecting overall Japan prices--BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Weak yen not affecting overall Japan prices--BOJ.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Friday that the yen's depreciation is not putting upward pressure on Japan's overall prices.
He told the budget committee of parliament's Upper House that the recently weak yen was helping push up import prices somewhat.
"However, it (the weak yen) is not yet putting upward pressure on Japan's overall prices," he said.
Matsushita also said the recent flow of funds out of Japan was not causing confusion in the markets.
"Although both the currency and the stock markets have moved drastically recently, the current flow of funds abroad has not caused confusion," he said.
He also said that the fund outflow was not caused only by interest rate differentials between Japan and other countries.
